featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello guys, if you are reading this please note that, this guy is complete scam as per my experience. He will act very nicely till you purchase and make the payment, after that he would even consider your issue. He has the habit of distracting and deviating from the main point, he won't let you speak and will keep changing the topic. Had bought a 2nd hand bike, and there was issue with mileage, the bike was hardly giving 30 -35 km/per litre average. Went to him with the issue, and he did not consider my request. He already knew that the bike was not giving mileage still he just repaired modified and sold the bike. I had a loss of around 5k to 6k for trying to repair and at the end had to again purchase a new activa because of the constant problems of the bike.
Complete scammer. He knew there was issue and still he sold the bike, and I got to know that bike was not giving average after few days, you'll know the issue of mileage only after riding it for 2 3 days.
Before buying anything from this guy, take your mechanic with you and have the bike checked or make a demand of returning the vehicle within 7 days or else you'll lose money just like I did. Don't fall into his sweet talk.

Regarding mileage, at the time of selling any second-hand Activa, we clearly inform customers that the average generally ranges between 30–35 km/l depending on riding style, road conditions, maintenance, and vehicle condition. As per your review, you mentioned receiving mileage within that range.

If you have spent ₹5,000–₹6,000 on repairs specifically to improve mileage, kindly share the repair bills and details of the work done. In most cases, improving mileage does not require such a high expense, as regular servicing like air filter replacement, carburetor tuning, or basic maintenance usually helps improve performance.

Also, congratulations on your new bike. Since we also purchase old bikes and Activas, why didn’t you sell it to us?

At present, as we are unable to verify this purchase or customer record, this review appears unclear or possibly not genuine. If this is a genuine review, we request you to share the above-mentioned details so we can properly verify the matter and assist you.

featured_reviews.name: Keshav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing and frustrating experience with this EV garage.

I visited on 21st March 2026, coming all the way from Malad, to get my Ola S1 Pro checked. The technician—who honestly looked underage and inexperienced—inspected the scooter and said the coneset needed replacement. I agreed and was told the scooter would be ready by the same evening.

Later that day, I received a call saying the technician had to leave, so I should collect the scooter the next day (22nd March). I agreed again, expecting the issue to be resolved.

However, on 22nd March (Sunday), around 1 PM, I got another call—this time claiming that my scooter “cannot be repaired at all.” To make matters worse, I was told the shop would close at 3 PM and that my scooter would be left outside on the street for me to pick up.

This is completely unacceptable. Leaving a customer’s vehicle unattended on the road is irresponsible—what if it gets towed or damaged? The lack of professionalism, poor communication, and careless attitude towards customer property is shocking.

I strongly recommend avoiding this place if you value your time, money, and vehicle. Definitely not worth the hassle.
